verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline strong on the left and the hiker large, but the 'Invites you…' copy is crushed into a narrow one-word-per-line column, the dates wrap vertically ('JUNE / 8-24…'), the cross is blown up and blurry, and 'Worship & Bible Study' is tiny and cut loose at the bottom. B keeps every text block readable and in the right order, but the whole group sits in the lower half under a big empty band at the top, the hiker illustration shrinks to a small thumbnail stuck on the right edge, and the dates line is tiny with a blurry cross dangling at the bottom left. B is the less bad of the two.
